image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a yellow-orange coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus). The image focuses on the intricate, upward-pointing branch tips which are cylindrical and bifurcating. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), emphasizing the depth of field. The texture appears smooth and matte. A dark, earthy substrate is visible in the bottom right corner.
